freeze.hash_scope: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this unit's model only, excluding this freeze block; a change to any other unit cannot move this digest
freeze.judge_dependency: none; no model or judge call was made by this build

constraints.expression: a third-party rating is a property of the entity; the holder's own attitude is l1:preference.affinity and the two must not be merged

provenance.evidence: average_rating (3 services), star_rating; Taskmaster2 rating 2993, score 3262, star_rating 2083

item.sense: an evaluative score attributed to an entity by parties other than the current holder

provenance.evidence: GetCarsAvailable and Calendar_1 GetAvailableTime make availability the queried attribute; SYSTEM INFORM_COUNT 1779 reports how much of it there is

item.sense: whether an entity can currently be obtained or used

provenance.evidence: date (4 services), departure_date (3), check_in_date (3), appointment_date (3), return_date, pickup_date, dropoff_date, leaving_date collapse to one family

item.sense: the day a situation is located on

constraints.expression: kept separate because SGD revises them independently: appointment_time 371 revisions against appointment_date 374, on the same appointments

provenance.evidence: time (3 services), appointment_time (3), pickup_time, leaving_time and four Flights outbound/inbound time slots; Taskmaster2 time 9087, time_of_day 3874

item.sense: the time of day a situation is located at, independent of which day

constraints.expression: this item says entities bear names; it holds no name. A stored name would be an Individual, which this ontology excludes

provenance.evidence: 'name' is the most frequent facet at 75676 occurrences and appears in every one of the 7 domains

item.sense: the name by which an entity is referred to, which identifies without describing

provenance.evidence: 'type' facet 25958 occurrences; SGD carries type/car_type/event_type/show_type/fare_type/ride_type as the same attribute under six service-local names

item.sense: the sub-category an entity belongs to within its own domain

constraints.expression: values are comparable, which is what l1:preference.threshold needs; an unordered attribute cannot be the range of a bound

provenance.evidence: price (4 services), total_price (3), fare (2), balance, amount, ride_fare plus the count family (passengers, party_size, number_of_rooms)

item.sense: a quantity on an ordered scale, so two values of it can be compared

provenance.evidence: city (6 services), street_address (6), address (3), location (3) plus Taskmaster2 location 11461 and sub_location 1893

item.sense: where an entity or situation is located, at any granularity

constraints.expression: a failed attempt must not be recorded as opening a state; treating NOTIFY_FAILURE like NOTIFY_SUCCESS would assert 302 arrangements that do not exist

provenance.evidence: SYSTEM NOTIFY_FAILURE 302 across 2559 dialogues; a failed attempt is attested and is not the negation of a success event

item.sense: a bounded occurrence in which an intended action did not achieve its result

constraints.expression: this event begins a state that outlives it, so an instance without a resulting l1:state.pending_arrangement is incompletely represented

provenance.evidence: NOTIFY_SUCCESS 1796 marks the moment a transactional intent completes, against NOTIFY_FAILURE 302 where no arrangement comes into existence

item.sense: a bounded occurrence in which an arrangement comes into existence

provenance.evidence: cancel_pending_order requires a reason from a closed set ('no longer needed', 'ordered by mistake'), so withdrawal is a distinct event with its own cause

item.sense: a bounded occurrence that ends an existing arrangement without fulfilling it

provenance.evidence: USER REQUEST 3394 and SYSTEM REQUEST 5008 are bounded ask events

item.sense: a bounded occurrence in which one party asks another for information

provenance.evidence: movie_search 45318 and music 21229 annotation instances, with streaming_service 2756 naming the instrument of consumption

item.sense: a bounded occurrence of experiencing a content item

provenance.evidence: INFORM 10647 by users and 3244 by the system present slot values

item.sense: presented as holding in the world, independent of anyone wanting it to

provenance.evidence: ke_memory_demo.domain.Modality.BELIEF already partitions this from FACT, and keeping the distinction preserves compatibility with extracted units

item.sense: presented as the speaker's belief, which may be wrong without being a lie

provenance.evidence: 13819 of 65245 persona sentences match an affect-positive pattern ('I like/love/enjoy/prefer'), the single largest attested attitude

item.sense: presented as wanted by the holder, without commitment to bringing it about

provenance.evidence: retail policy requires explicit user confirmation before consequential actions, so a directive is a distinct attitude from a stated preference

item.sense: presented as an instruction the addressee is expected to comply with

provenance.evidence: INFORM_INTENT 3952 and AFFIRM_INTENT 680 commit the user to an intent; 1061 MSC persona sentences match 'I want/plan/hope to'

item.sense: presented as a commitment by the agent to bring the situation about

provenance.evidence: AFFIRM 2070 and AFFIRM_INTENT 680

item.sense: the assertion holds as stated

provenance.evidence: NEGATE 2127 and NEGATE_INTENT 407; MSC contributes 970 affect-negative persona sentences ('I hate', "I don't like")

item.sense: the assertion is stated not to hold, which is content and not absence of content

provenance.evidence: ke_memory_demo.domain.Polarity.UNKNOWN exists for extracted units, and an ontology without it would force a wrong choice at mapping time

item.sense: the assertion's polarity cannot be recovered from what was said

constraints.expression: an instance is only well-formed if a prior commit_to_arrangement is recoverable; tau-bench refuses to modify an order that is not pending

provenance.evidence: retail exposes cancel_pending_order, modify_pending_order_address/items/payment and airline exposes cancel_reservation and three update_reservation_* tools

item.sense: the agent alters or withdraws an arrangement that already exists

constraints.expression: a commitment is only complete when the counterparty confirms; tau-bench retail policy requires explicit user 'yes' before any write
an arrangement may later be modified or cancelled, so an instance is not terminal; tau-bench exposes cancel and modify for reservations

provenance.evidence: Reserve (7) + Book (4) + Schedule (1) = 12 intent names, and every one has is_transactional true

item.sense: the agent binds itself to a future arrangement, creating an obligation on both sides

provenance.evidence: Play (3) intents -- PlaySong, PlayMovie, PlayMedia -- are transactional yet create no obligation, so they are neither seek_information nor commitment

item.sense: the agent experiences a content item, which changes no arrangement and leaves a trace

constraints.expression: an instance must carry a l1:qualifier.polarity value, because the same predicate covers 13819 like-patterns and 970 dislike-patterns in MSC

provenance.evidence: 13819 affect-positive and 970 affect-negative persona sentences share one argument frame and differ only in polarity

item.sense: a holder stands in an evaluative relation to a theme, positively or negatively

provenance.evidence: 14288 ongoing-state and 8660 possession persona sentences describe a durable relation with no evaluative component

item.sense: a holder stands in a durable non-evaluative relation to a place, activity or entity

constraints.expression: an instance of this sense must not be recorded as changing any state; SGD marks 29 of 53 intents non-transactional and these are those

provenance.evidence: Find (12) + Search (7) + Lookup (2) + Check (1) = 22 of 53 intent names, and all 22 belong to intents with is_transactional false

item.sense: the agent tries to obtain information about a theme without changing anything

constraints.expression: a value transfer names the means, because reversing it depends on the means: tau-bench refunds a gift card immediately and a card in 5-7 days

provenance.evidence: Buy (5) + Transfer (1) intents, all transactional; Banks_1 TransferMoney requires amount and recipient_account_name together

item.sense: the agent gives up something of value and a recipient acquires it

provenance.evidence: 13819 affect-positive and 970 affect-negative persona sentences; the largest single attested preference shape

item.sense: the holder is favourably or unfavourably disposed towards a theme, taken on its own

constraints.expression: two affinity items with the same polarity do not entail a ranking, so a comparative may not be synthesised from them

provenance.evidence: USER SELECT 2577 chooses among offered alternatives and REQUEST_ALTS 1397 rejects the current offer in favour of another, both ranking acts

item.sense: the holder ranks one theme above another, which neither theme's affinity alone states

provenance.evidence: ordered categorical ranges support bounds: Restaurants_1 price_range ['inexpensive'..'very expensive'] and Hotels_1 star_rating ['1'..'5']

item.sense: the holder wants an attribute to stay within a bound, rather than favouring a theme

provenance.evidence: 3661 of 5110 dialogues (71.6%) revise at least one user slot value mid-dialogue; city 571, departure_date 516, date 456

item.sense: whether the assertion still stands or has been replaced by a later one

provenance.evidence: INFORM_INTENT 3952 and AFFIRM_INTENT 680 mark a wanted situation, distinct from INFORM 10647 marking an asserted one

item.sense: the attitude the assertion carries towards its content: asserted, wanted, planned

provenance.evidence: NEGATE 2127 against AFFIRM 2070 and NEGATE_INTENT 407 against AFFIRM_INTENT 680: denial is as frequent as affirmation

item.sense: whether the assertion affirms or denies that its content holds

provenance.evidence: the speaker field partitions all acts into USER and SYSTEM, and NOTIFY_SUCCESS 1796 / NOTIFY_FAILURE 302 report a system-side outcome

item.sense: who or what vouches for the content: the user, the assistant, a tool, or inference

provenance.evidence: date/time slots are ubiquitous (date in 4 services, time in 3) and are always about the described situation, not the utterance

item.sense: when the described situation holds, relative to the moment it was asserted

provenance.evidence: USER INFORM 10647 and SYSTEM OFFER 10569 are acts by distinct initiators; every intent in schema.json is performed by one of the two

item.sense: the participant who initiates the event and whose action brings it about

provenance.evidence: the 3-part annotation names split frame.facet.filler, so the bearer position is separate from the facet; 'name' fills it 75676 times

item.sense: the entity an attribute is predicated of, as distinct from the attribute value

provenance.evidence: search intents pass user restrictions as slot values, e.g. Restaurants_1 price_range over ['inexpensive'..'very expensive'] narrows a search

item.sense: what a preference or requirement restricts, as opposed to the value it restricts it to

provenance.evidence: 65245 persona sentences ascribe states to a subject who performs no action: 14288 match an ongoing-state pattern such as 'I live/work/am'

item.sense: the participant a state or preference is true of, who need not act for it to hold

provenance.evidence: retail order changes require payment_method_id and Music services require playback_device, both a means rather than a theme

item.sense: the means by which the agent brings the event about, including a tool or channel

provenance.evidence: a count family recurs with service-specific names: passengers, travelers, group_size, party_size, number_of_seats, number_of_tickets, number_of_rooms

item.sense: how many units of the theme the predicate applies to

provenance.evidence: Banks_1 separates account_type from recipient_account_type and recipient_account_name, so sender and receiver are separate positions

item.sense: the participant who receives the theme, distinct from the agent who sends it

provenance.evidence: origin/from_location/from_station/origin_airport appear as an origin family across Buses, Flights and RideSharing services

item.sense: the place or state a movement or transition starts from

provenance.evidence: destination appears in 5 services and destination_airport/to_location/to_station in others; Taskmaster2 records destination1 4018 times

item.sense: the place or state a movement or transition ends at

provenance.evidence: every transactional intent (24 of 53) names the thing acted on in its required_slots, for instance TransferMoney requires amount

item.sense: the entity the predicate is about, created, changed or transferred by the event

provenance.evidence: SYSTEM OFFER 10569 and SYSTEM INFORM 3244 originate system-side

item.sense: the assistant produced the content, so it inherits the assistant's reliability

provenance.evidence: SYSTEM CONFIRM 10387 followed by USER AFFIRM 2070 is the corpus's most frequent agreement structure; tau-bench policy mandates it before writes

item.sense: user and assistant explicitly agreed on the content, so neither alone is the authority

provenance.evidence: ke_memory_demo.online.SourceStatus.DERIVED already exists, and every L2 abstraction will carry this status, so it must be nameable at L1

item.sense: the content was inferred from other content and has no independent source of its own

provenance.evidence: get_order_details, get_reservation_details and get_user_details return backend state rather than dialogue content

item.sense: a tool or backend returned the content, which is checkable independently of the dialogue

provenance.evidence: 10647 USER INFORM acts are the user's own report of a value

item.sense: the user is the authority for the content; nothing else corroborates it

provenance.evidence: ke_memory_demo.domain.Lifecycle.ACTIVE

item.sense: no later assertion has replaced this one

provenance.evidence: NEGATE_INTENT 407 abandons a declared intent without providing another, which is withdrawal rather than substitution

item.sense: the asserter withdrew the content without substituting a replacement value

provenance.evidence: 71.6% of 5110 dialogues revise a slot value, so supersession is the common case rather than an exception

item.sense: a later assertion about the same subject and attribute replaced this one

constraints.expression: a constraint cannot be traded off the way a preference can; conflating them makes a hard requirement look like a rankable option

provenance.evidence: tau-bench policy states hard limits (a gift card must cover the total; item modification cannot change product type) that are not preferences

item.sense: a standing limit on what the holder can do or accept, not a matter of taste

constraints.expression: a new value supersedes the old while remaining the same state; SGD revises city 571 times and departure_date 516 times in 5110 dialogues

provenance.evidence: 14288 of 65245 persona sentences assert an ongoing circumstance ('I live in', 'I work as', 'I am a')

item.sense: a durable non-evaluative fact about a holder, such as where they live or what they do

constraints.expression: this state ends by fulfilment or by l1:event.commitment_withdrawn, and not by the passage of time alone

provenance.evidence: tau-bench order status is a four-value lifecycle (pending, processed, delivered, cancelled) and only pending permits modification

item.sense: an arrangement exists and its obligations have not yet been discharged

provenance.evidence: 8660 of 65245 persona sentences match an 'I have/own' pattern

item.sense: a holder has something at their disposal over an interval

provenance.evidence: NEGATE_INTENT 407 abandons a previously declared intent, so abandonment is attested as its own outcome rather than as an absent completion

item.sense: an aim the agent declared and then gave up without achieving it

constraints.expression: an L1 task is what one turn makes explicit; anything requiring evidence from a second turn is an O_L2 abstraction and not this item

provenance.evidence: USER INFORM_INTENT 3952 declares an aim in one turn, and SYSTEM OFFER_INTENT 1087 proposes one

item.sense: the agent states an aim it has not yet achieved, at a granularity resolvable in one turn

constraints.expression: this item ends when the missing value is supplied, so it is not a preference and must not survive its own satisfaction

provenance.evidence: required_slots on each intent names exactly what is outstanding; SYSTEM REQUEST 5008 is the act of asking for one of them

item.sense: a specific piece of information or action still missing before an intention can complete

provenance.evidence: forward-looking slots are pervasive: check_in_date, departure_date, appointment_date, pickup_date all denote a situation not yet realised

item.sense: the situation is expected or scheduled to hold after the moment of assertion

provenance.evidence: 14288 persona sentences assert a state holding at utterance time

item.sense: the situation holds at the moment of assertion

provenance.evidence: 1632 of 65245 persona sentences match a past-event pattern ('I used to', 'I graduated', 'I moved')

item.sense: the situation held or occurred before the moment of assertion

provenance.evidence: 80 of 65245 persona sentences match an explicit frequency pattern ('usually', 'always', 'every day'); rare but structurally distinct

item.sense: the situation holds repeatedly on some cycle rather than once

provenance.evidence: paired boundary slots define intervals: check_in_date/check_out_date, outbound_departure_time/inbound_arrival_time; Taskmaster2 date_range 2469

item.sense: the situation holds over an interval rather than at a point

provenance.evidence: the majority of persona sentences carry no temporal marker at all, so an explicit unspecified value prevents a default of 'present' being invented

item.sense: no temporal location is recoverable from the assertion
